mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log ( id, household_id, actor_account_id, subject_account_id, action, outcome, detail, ip_address, request_id, created_at ) VALUES ( gen_random_uuid(), #{householdId, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}, #{actorAccountId, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}, #{subjectAccountId, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}, #{action}, #{outcome}, #{detail, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{ipAddress}, #{requestId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, actor_account_id, subject_account_id, action, outcome, detail, ip_address, request_id, created_at FROM audit_log WHERE actor_account_id = #{actorAccountId, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY created_at DESC
